# R3.5 preparation requirements-quality checklist

**Purpose**: Owner review of contract clarity and design traceability before preparation merge.
**Created**: 2026-10-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Depth/audience**: Standard, owner PR reviewer; focus on durability, concurrency and acceptance.

**Review ownership**: Generated by speckit-checklist. Items stay unchecked until
the reviewer evaluates written requirements. A checked item means requirements
quality approval, never implementation completion. Existing checklists are preserved.

## Durability and provenance

- [ ] CHK001 Are complete-read retention, returned-summary replacement and no deletion from missing identities unambiguous across the contract and derived design? [Consistency, FR-005–FR-010; data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK002 Are source success, local-save failure and the exact prior saved view specified separately, including no previously saved rows and a fresh-read Retry? [Exception coverage, FR-007; US2.9]
- [ ] CHK003 Are legacy populated/empty adoption, unknown times and unreadable recovery distinguished without inventing freshness or treating errors as absence? [Completeness, FR-009/018; DEC-001/003]
- [ ] CHK004 Are saved observation time, returned membership, per-run time and current attempt wording consistently defined for subset, empty and failed observations? [Clarity, FR-008/009; US3.1–2]

## Navigation, clearing and failure boundaries

- [ ] CHK005 Are launch contexts, logical entry, non-entry presentation changes and one-action Settings/return budgets precise and consistent? [Clarity, FR-001/003/004; DEC-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Are clear cancellation, durable success/failure, late callbacks and later intentional reimport covered without contradicting one-read concurrency? [Recovery coverage, FR-011–FR-013; DEC-004]
- [ ] CHK007 Are local-data, unit preference, HealthKit permission/source and reset/restoration boundaries explicit in all confirmation/guidance requirements? [Scope, FR-011/014/017/019]

## Coverage and review gates

- [ ] CHK008 Are all FRs, all story scenarios and SC-001–SC-007 traceable to stable tasks and measurable validation without broadening approved scope? [Traceability, tasks.md coverage tables]
- [ ] CHK009 Are all Dynamic Type sizes, non-color provenance, VoiceOver and compact/resized layouts covered by clear acceptance criteria? [Measurability, FR-015; SC-006]
- [ ] CHK010 Are automated evidence, physical iPhone/iPad acceptance and pending performance measurements clearly distinguished, with immutable task IDs and shared-file ownership? [Evidence quality, SC-001/007; plan.md; execution.json]

## Notes

This checklist tests the written contract/design's quality, not runtime behavior.
Implementation workers read markers and do not change them. Owner reviews it
alongside history.md; their unchecked state does not negate the actual merged
specification approval. No additional product clarification is currently required.
